data.title: 伊雷娜 · 云端飞行
data.description: 【伊蕾娜 · 云端飞行】澄澈如洗的万里碧空之上，身披黑色魔女斗篷与尖顶帽的伊蕾娜轻巧地跨坐在飞天扫帚上。狂风卷起她瀑布般的银白长发，她迎着高空气流回眸露出自信耀眼的微笑——「在云层之上自由飞翔的美丽魔女究竟是谁呢？没错，就是我——灰之魔女伊蕾娜哦！」
data.promptProse: Elaina rides astride her magic broomstick above the vast white cloud sea, smiling at the journey as aerial wind lifts her black witch dress and frilled skirt. The star brooch remains visible in the wide view, broom extending beneath her balanced pose. Brilliant blue sky opens beyond overlapping cloud banks. High-altitude sunlight lights her silver hair and upper sleeves, while cloud reflections brighten the broom's underside against the deeper blue distance.
